references.phrase: zero morphism and equation p composed with f equals zero
references.context: The additive identity arrow in an abelian hom-set; p annihilates f under composition.
Any morphism q:Y to Z annihilating f uniquely factors as h composed with p, for one h:C to Z.
There is exactly one arrow from cokernel object C to Z satisfying q=h composed with p.

references.disposition: A general preadditive category need not supply a cokernel of every morphism; the definition is conditional on an exhibiting universal arrow.

review_rationale: Reviewed cokernel universal property for a morphism in a preadditive category, requiring p f=0 and unique factorization of any other arrow annihilating f; existence conditional.
